gloss: to sharpen; to point; to purse (lips)

definitions.gloss: to sharpen; to make pointed; to purse (lips)
definitions.explanation: To make something pointy at the tip. Also used figuratively with {口|くち} (mouth/lips) to mean pouting or sulking, and with {神経|しんけい} (nerves) to mean being on edge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→鉛筆：00694_enpitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尖|とが}らせる。
⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尖|とが}らせて⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: My little brother pursed his lips and complained.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尖|とが}らせて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The players were on edge before the match.

notes:
The transitive/causative form of ⟦{尖|とが}る→尖る：00405_togaru⟧ (to become pointed).

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive (takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧). Pairs with intransitive ⟦{尖|とが}る→尖る：00405_togaru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{鉛筆|えんぴつ}→鉛筆：00694_enpitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尖|とが}らせる: to sharpen a pencil
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尖|とが}らせる: to pout; to purse one's lips (in displeasure)
- ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尖|とが}らせる: to be on edge; to be highly alert
- ⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尖|とが}らせる: to listen sharply

USAGE:
⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尖|とが}らせる is the standard way to describe a sulky or complaining facial expression. ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尖|とが}らせる describes heightened sensitivity or vigilance, often about a specific issue.
